public_rationale: The January 21, 2025 Stargate announcement assigned financial responsibility to SoftBank while naming multiple equity funders [e2]. On May 12, Sherwood News summarized Bloomberg reporting that tariff uncertainty had stalled SoftBank financing for the initial $100 billion program and that oversupply concerns might be slowing discussions [e3]. This supports financing difficulty during May 1–27, with financial responsibility understood as arranging financing [e2, e3].
limitations: The fundraising evidence rests on one underlying Bloomberg report, accessed through Sherwood's summary.
Private financing records were not available.
The evidence does not establish sole financial liability, eventual fundraising failure, or daily conditions through May 27.

public_payload.normalized_proposition: SoftBank, which will have full financial responsibility for Stargate, is having trouble raising the supposed $100 billion to build it.

statement.excerpt: As a note, SoftBank, who will have full financial responsibility for the project, is having trouble raising the supposed $100 billion to build it.

from_speaker: full financial responsibility for the project
our_interpretation: The project means the initial US Stargate funding program, rather than a separate $100 billion budget for Abilene or the UAE.

Financial responsibility means responsibility for arranging financing. The surrounding passage expressly identifies other capital contributors, so it does not mean SoftBank alone must supply every dollar.
Having trouble means material impediments or delays in securing financing, not eventual inability to raise it.
For this ongoing fundraising observation, the target is the current reporting month through publication, May 1–27, 2025.
criteria.support_condition: Contemporaneous reporting establishes material obstacles or delays in financing the initial $100 billion program, with SoftBank assigned the financing role.
criteria.contradiction_condition: Reliable records establish that the initial financing was secured without the alleged impediments, or that SoftBank did not have the financing role.
